shots.what: Low dolly from her front three-quarter to her side: she sprints left to right through the tall grass, fox bobbing, torii and shrine hill behind
shots.cue: bar 7 downbeat - theme enters (section start, on motion)
shots.note: Moved here from bar 8 per review: the theme lands on her, low beside her, grass parting at her feet. She moves to screen right.

shots.what: Game camera low behind her, tilted up (real input W+D+Shift): she sprints through the long grass toward the village, the fox spirit flying overhead against the sky
shots.note: Re-shoot. Game camera looking up pulls in close, so she is large. A thin fence post passes far left around take frames 85-95. She moves to screen right, houses of the village ahead (leads into bar 9).

shots.what: Game camera: she sprints past the village fields; the farmer hoes in mid-ground left, thatched houses, the night dome on the horizon
shots.note: in=18 skips the game camera settling at the head. Farmer visible working roughly frames 20-100 of the take. A thatched eave edges into the top-right corner in the last ~8 used frames (camera passing a house).

shots.what: Dolly with her across the shrine courtyard, left to right; the old woman sweeps the stone path behind her, the red hall behind
shots.note: Old woman sweeping is readable mid-background around take frames 50-120; a banner pole wipes the foreground near frame 60.

shots.what: Camera rides beside her: she sprints off the shrine hill edge, leaps, jumps again and the wings of light open; glide out over the land, left to right
shots.cue: bar 11 downbeat - caption 一片永昼　一片薄暮　一片长夜 fades in
shots.note: Take-off on take frame 16 (section +6); second jump / wings opening ~take frame 46 = section beat 2 of bar 11. Caption 一片永昼　一片薄暮　一片长夜: the sky here is pale, so centre it (x=960, review found it ~190 px right) and give it a soft dark backing, or set it lower over the green slope (y about 780-880), which is darker and calm in this shot.

shots.what: A real glide: the camera trails behind her right shoulder then swings out to flank her as she glides down over the day fields and the river toward the red dusk forest; she crosses left to right, the fox above
shots.note: Re-shoot per review. She descends about 6 m over the shot; the land streams below. Caption: centre it (x=960), soft dark backing; the sky upper third is warm pale, the dome sits top-right in the first half.

shots.what: Game camera over the red dusk forest: she lets go of the wings and calls the broom (F) - the summoning circle - and flies on toward the great red maple
shots.note: Broom summoned by real input on take frame 18 (half a beat after the cut); circle peaks ~frames 30-50. Motion blur 8.

shots.what: Side follow over the mirror lake: she rides the broom left to right low over the water, reflections, the dusk shore passing
High wide over the town of lanterns in the lasting night: her broom trail crosses the frame left to right above the roofs
shots.note: Motion blur 8. She is small here on purpose (a scale shot); her trail leads the eye.

shots.what: Game camera on the broom, diving down into the glowing mushroom wood
shots.note: Motion blur 8. Ends section 2; section 3 starts at the next bar line.
